2026-11-19.note: First Push B: pick the new lifts' weights by feel and stop 2 reps before failure.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Same weight: 7 on every set, so aim for 8 first.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same weight: 7 on every set, just under 8, so get 8 first.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Much lighter: 4 to 7 reps at 10 kg, 12 asked. Start with the left arm, it lags. Use another cable station if the 5 kg setting fails.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg: you did 12 there, so aim for 10 on every set.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Same weight, more reps: 10 on every set, go for 12.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Same weight, more reps: 12 on every set, go for 14.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Much lighter: 6 reps at 10 to 15 kg and shoulder pain. If it hurts again, stop and switch to the face pull.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Much lighter: 5 reps at 10 kg, 12 asked. Start with the left arm. Use another station if the 5 kg setting fails.

pullA:curl.coach: Same weight: 7, 6 and 4 fell under 8. Rest longer and get 8 on every set.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again: 10 on every set, go for 12, then add the first plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Same 20 kg on the cable: the first set got only 6, so get 10 on every set.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Same weight, more reps: 10 on every set, go for 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow: 8 done, 12 asked. Use the lightest pin if 12 is not there, and drop it if the knee hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Same weight, more reps: 10 on both sets, go for 12.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Same, more reps: 10 on both sets, go for 12.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift about 8 times with 2 reps to spare. The empty bar is fine to start.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Same weight as Push A: 7 there, 8 is the bottom here.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Lighter: 9 reps at 5 kg on Push A, 12 asked here.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips leaning forward. If you cannot get 8, use the chest press machine instead.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick a weight a bit under your 20 kg pushdown that gives you about 12 reps with 2 to spare.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Light: 5 reps at 10 kg before, 15 asked here. Start with the left arm.

cable-lateral.note: The 5 kg setting on that cable machine does not work.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.

rdl.note: Done on the cable machine, not the barbell.
